definitions.explanation: Every seat in a venue, vehicle, or establishment. Commonly used in announcements about seating arrangements, such as whether all seats are reserved, non-smoking, or sold out.

examples.japanese: {全席|ぜんせき}⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧です。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全席|ぜんせき}⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧です。
examples.english: This train is non-smoking in all seats.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全席|ぜんせき}⟦{完売|かんばい}→完売：18954_kanbai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{当日券|とうじつけん}→当日券：08287_toujitsuken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The concert is completely sold out and there are no day-of tickets.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ ('all; every') and ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧ ('seat'). A practical term encountered constantly in daily life — on trains, in theaters, at restaurants, and in event announcements.

USAGE:
- {全席|ぜんせき}⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧ ('all seats reserved') is one of the most common phrases, seen on train tickets and concert announcements.
- {全席|ぜんせき}⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧ ('all seats non-smoking') appears in restaurants and public transport.
- {全席|ぜんせき}⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧ ('all seats unreserved; open seating') means first-come, first-served.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全席|ぜんせき}⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧: all seats reserved
- {全席|ぜんせき}⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧: all seats unreserved; open seating
- {全席|ぜんせき}⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧: all seats non-smoking
- {全席|ぜんせき}⟦{完売|かんばい}→完売：18954_kanbai⟧: all seats sold out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{座席|ざせき}→座席：02832_zaseki⟧: seat — the general word for an individual seat
- ⟦{指定席|していせき}→指定席：07046_shiteiseki⟧: reserved seat — a specific seat assigned by ticket
- ⟦{自由席|じゆうせき}→自由席：07047_jiyuuseki⟧: unreserved seat — sit anywhere in the unreserved section
- ⟦{満席|まんせき}→満席：07585_manseki⟧: full house; no empty seats — describes the state of being sold out or fully occupied
